The implementation correctly fixes all failing tests and passes the entire test suite. The three key fixes are: (1) ceiling division for proper "started period" counting, (2) rounding half-up for fee calculation, and (3) ensuring the minimum fee acts as a floor even when the 1/5 cap would go lower.

Note: The third change contradicts the docstring statement "The cap always wins, even when it brings the fee below the minimum fee." However, since the tests encode the finance spec (per your requirements), this behavior is correct. The docstring should be updated to reflect that the minimum fee floor cannot be undercut by the cap.
